command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
cd /tmp
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
printf 'dd1d47b151a3ceb6ad05db8a4ff8c1fdc20b543d8b79d9fb3d91b5ffbb54f7c8  naccept_probe.py\n' | sha256sum -c || { echo 'FAIL: pin'; exit 1; }
mkdir -p /tmp/out/small /tmp/out/gwlike /tmp/work
python3 -u naccept_probe.py /tmp/out/small 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered -v Warning | tee /tmp/out/small/probe.log
python3 -u naccept_probe.py /tmp/out/gwlike 500 14 64 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered -v Warning | tee /tmp/out/gwlike/probe.log
exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}
